newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen, IMF meet to discuss economic reforms.
newsitem.headline: Yemen, IMF meet to discuss economic reforms.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund team on Tuesday began talks with Yemeni officials to assess the impoverished Arab state's economic reform programme, Sanaa radio reported.
It said the talks covered Yemen's efforts to push ahead with the programme launched in March 1995 in agreement with the World Bank and IMF.
The radio said Yemen has managed to cut inflation to 12 percent in 1996 from 71 percent last year.
Yemen, a small oil producer, is suffering from unemployment ranging from 30 to 50 percent.
It has received soft loans from several countries and international organisations under its reform plan that has included raising the prices of fuel and electricity, water and telephone rates.
Last year such measures sparked brief riots.
